scope: Author static self-review against copied original runtime.hpp and current Graph/VisitedTable source; no compile, search, scoring, training or vector reads.
contracts_checked: Original GT R is used once for route/slot plan and first-arrival candidate dedup; partial missing-label fallback does not score or commit partial candidates.
Original fresh scalar order is all valid R then all C. Candidate words are kept in original records and reused for seed choice without negation, promotion or callback.
Full old-C strict merge sorts and emits a successful complete M5 packet before any X scoring; X nonfinite leaves that packet in I/D and retains incurred physical counters.
Query-best seed uses the same distance/priority comparator as old merge; first mode picks first eligible row target. Row winners are deduplicated in route order with no replacement.
Graph slots rotate route row0/row1/row2 at each physical slot. Neighbors filter invalid IDs, main-seen, original C and X in that frozen category order.
main-vt and graph are const references; no advance, set_query, search reentry or base/index allocation/copy.
Extra physical scalar cap is 0/24/96 and checked by nx<cap before calls; bounded X ID scratch96 plus original C24. Original K R reference callbacks are separately charged.
Original R/C Record priorities retained; every X priority is K+nc+arrival, strictly after all original R/C. Duplicate and EqCmp candidates never use priority to override strict admission.

Optional audit stores actual R/C/X words, source rows and failure state; timed null audit has no trace writes. Post dots/commits remain M5-stage counts, new_distances is X-stage calls; post row_reads includes physical seed target-row rescans.
All working score ranges are K<=100, nc<=24, nx<=96; old Posting records indexes remain below124 and logical heap range is exactly K.
limits: Lexical/static checks and reasoning do not establish compilation, ABI/native FP parity or output correctness; runner must compile and execute authorized parity/audit gates.

No universal lossless Recall or QPS claim. Saved packet preserves old M5 on the implemented normal nonfinite-X fallback; arbitrary traps/throws/unsupported callback side effects are not transactionally recovered.
Different posting-row provenance is not proven different seed basin, modality gap or causal cross-modal benefit.
No actual query-specific full graph/visited domain or natural-epoch evidence was generated by this child; caller binds it in the actual runner.
